productArea.name: Extensions and their webhooks
productArea.scope: Browse, install, and manage manifest apps, custom apps, and plugins, including permissions, tokens, activation, and synchronous or asynchronous webhooks. External extension applications and notification settings are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Extensions then Installed, and open a manifest app, custom app, or plugin for its settings. Custom app details link to token and webhook controls.
Choose Extensions then Explore to browse available extensions and installation options.
Use Install from manifest to enter a manifest URL and review permissions.
Use Create custom app to configure a custom extension.
